description: Summarization decided by Jev in one request: two Nouls, a Score and one Noul per assessment question

assessment_questions: Does the park open in May?
Will the park have a café?

test_case.input: The city council approved a new riverside park on Monday. Construction starts in March and the park opens in May. It will have a lake, a playground and 200 new trees.
test_case.actual_output: The council approved a riverside park with a lake. It opens in June.
